title: Vedhalam
desc: Ganesh, a taxi driver, leads a peaceful life. One day, upon helping the police seize three criminals, he incurs the wrath of a criminal network, following which his real identity is revealed.

title: Alangu
desc: While trying to cross over to Kerala, a Tamil tribal boy and his group of friends get drawn into communal clashes that erupt along the state border.

title: Thenkasipattanam
desc: A man, who harbours feelings for his childhood friend, hides the truth from his best friend. However, trouble arises when his best friend falls in love with her.

title: Ace
desc: Kannan's hope to start a new life abroad is cut short when he gets mixed up with dangerous people. He must outwit fate itself to escape the predicament he is in.

title: The Game
desc: Detective Seo Joon-Young teams up with Kim Tae-Pyung to resolve a serial killer case using Tae-Pyung's unique ability to predict a person's death.

title: Remo
desc: SK, an aspiring actor, falls in love with Kavya, a doctor. However, she is engaged to another man and SK tries to sabotage their relationship by making her fall for him.
